final_followup_message.subject: 4-point diagnostic checklist for multi-agent loops & lock contention
final_followup_message.body:
Hi Klaus,

Following up on multi-agent execution safety: sharing a 4-point Black-Box Diagnostic Checklist our team uses to isolate whether agent loop stalls stem from file lock contention vs async subprocess timeouts—without needing code access:

1. Mutex vs Timeout Contention (Inspect sanitized exit codes & lock lifecycles)
2. Monotonic Wall-Clock Deadlines (Enforce wall-clock bounds on subagent delegation)
3. Stale PID Lock Reclamation (Verify orphaned lock auto-cleanup on worker crashes)
4. Token-Velocity Limits (Validate circuit breakers against runaway retry storms)

If you'd like us to run the full 15-point audit on one sample log for €99 fixed (24h SLA), reply 'AUDIT'. Otherwise, hope the 4-point checklist is a useful diagnostic reference for your team.

Best regards,
2026-Courier Commercial Engineering
